reviewed_by: Claude review of the approved chat side terminal (Figma 'Chat side terminal', nodes 44:3 and 44:88)
reason: The Workbench chat gains a terminal toggle that shows the existing persistent live shell beside the conversation (resizable, width and open state remembered per device; stacked below the chat on phones with secondary controls deferred to the full Terminal tab). 'Run in terminal' from the chat now opens that pane and sends the command there instead of switching screens; from other views it keeps the previous behaviour. The new catalogued journey drives a mocked terminal websocket and asserts the command frame, side-by-side geometry, keyboard resize, remembered state, hide/show, and handoff to the Terminal tab on desktop, compact, narrow and all six mobile projects; the existing Terminal-with-Assistant journey, compact terminal, Workbench header/sidebar icons, transcript search layout and toolbar-action geometry areas guard neighbouring layouts. Frontend tests cover App and the Workbench session hooks.
exclusions: No full suites. Python is unaffected. Visual review used the branch build against the live Core with its real terminal at 1512px and 390px in Zero Dark with no horizontal overflow; physical devices and the desktop Tauri window were not exercised.
